title: Computability theory: further developments
area_fit: Further branches should develop their own central questions and prerequisites from the existing finite-stage, oracle, degree and finite-information treatments.

later_research_branches.scope: A genuine example separating truth-table from weak truth-table reducibility. The existing separation of weak truth-table and Turing reducibility does not establish this different comparison.
Minimal degrees, Sacks density and c.e. minimal pairs, with the additional construction methods and preservation arguments they require.
Maximal sets and an incomplete high c.e. construction. Ordinary jump inversion at the second halting problem does not supply the latter construction.
The joint ADN–Arslanov theorem for incomplete c.e. oracles, and fixed-point methods for arbitrary precomplete numberings, require separate uniformity and representation arguments.
Selman’s nonuniform-to-uniform characterization and structural enumeration-degree results require separate uniformity and construction arguments.
Higher genericity, algorithmic randomness and algorithmic information, including the required measure and coding foundations.
Hyperarithmetic theory and reverse mathematics need separate foundational development before their substantial results are used.
Lambda-calculus models and word, tiling and Post correspondence applications are separate branches. Resource complexity and Hilbert’s tenth problem also require foundations in neighboring areas.
